tei:titleStmt.tei:title: ༄༅/ /bla ma dgyes pa rdo rje yi/ /sgrub thabs nyung ngu rnam gsal 'di/ /blo gsal lam gyi sa mkhan te/ /yon tan rgya mtsho'i dpal sbyin bzhugs/ /
༄༅/ /bla ma dgyes pa rdo rje yi/ /sgrub thabs nyung ngu rnam gsal 'di/ /blo gsal lam gyi sa mkhan te/ /yon tan rgya mtsho'i dpal sbyin bzhugs/ /

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// bla ma dgyes pa rdo rje yi// sgrub thabs nyung ngu rnam gsal 'di// blo gsal lam gyi sa mkhan te// yon tan rgya mtsho'i dpal sbyin bzhugs// ༈ /na mo gu ru bhyaḥ

dpal kyai rdo rje'i mngon lus lam dus mdor bsdus ni/ thog mar skyabs yul gsal btab/ bdag dang 'gro ba khams gsum nam mkha' yi// mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can ma lus pa// dus 'di nas bzung byang chub ma thob bar// phyogs bcu dus gsum bde gshegs thams cad kyi// sku gsung thugs dang yon tan phrin las rnams// gcig tu 'dus pa sangs rgyas kun gyi dngos// chos phung brgyad khri bzhi stong 'byung ba'i gnas// 'phags pa'i dge 'dun kun gyi mnga' bdag che// dpal ldan rtsa brgyud bla ma'i tshogs rnams dang*// spang rtogs mthar phyin ston pa rdzogs sangs rgyas// des gsungs chos dang tshogs mchog dge 'dun cher// sgo gsum gus pa chen pos skyabs su mchi// zhes ci nus mthar/ bla ma mchog dang dkon mchog rin po che// rnam pa gsum la phyag 'tshal skyabs su mchi// khyed kyis bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi// lus ngag yid gsum byin gyis brlab tu gsol// skyabs yul 'od zhu rang la thim par gyur// sems bskyed ni/ ma gyur 'gro rnams srid las bsgral ba'i phyir// bdag gis rdzogs pa'i byang chub thob par bya// de yi ched du snying po kyai rdo rje'i// lam gyi rim pa nyams su blangs bar bgyi// lan gsum/ de nas rdo rje sems dpa'i sgom bzlas ni/ rang gi spyi bor pad zla'i gdan steng du// bla ma rdo sems yab yum gsal ba yi// thugs kar zla steng hūm̐ las bdud rtsi'i rgyun// babs pas sdig sgrib nyes ltung kun sbyangs gyur// oṃ shrī badzra he ru ka sa mā ya/ ma nu sogs nas ci nus bzlas mthar thal mo sbyar nas/ bla ma thog mtha' med pa'i sems dpa' yis// bdag gis sngon bsags sdig sgrib nyes ltung kun// byang zhing dag par byin gyis brlab tu gsol// spyi bo'i rdor sems 'od zhu rang la thim// bla ma'i rnal 'byor 'dir 'don/ bsdu na/ rin chen mkhyen brtse'i gsungs/

gnas lugs bde chen rang rtsal dngos po'i gshis// ma bcos lhun grub mchog gsum 'dus pa'i dngos// bla ma rdo rje 'dzin mchod gsol btab pas// smin grol lhan skyes sku bzhi mngon gyur shog / ces dang*/ sngon 'gro tshogs bsags ni/ rang nyid kyai rdor thugs ka'i hūm̐ 'od kyis// bla ma yi dam lha dgu sa mā dza// gus pas phyag 'tshal phyi nang gsang gsum mchod// sdig ltung mthol bshags dge la rjes yi rang*// don dam sems bzung skyabs gsum mchog tu bsnyen// sangs rgyas thob phyir lam 'jug dge tshogs bsngo// spyi dang bye brag sdom pa ma lus bzung*// 'gro kun bde ldan sdug bsngal kun dang bral// bde gnas btang snyoms ngang la gnas gyur cig /oṃ shū n+ya tā'i sngags kyis stong par sbyangs// stong pa'i ngang las bsrung 'khor dur khrod nang*// tsakra rtsibs bcu khro bcu dang bcas dbus// chos 'byung nang tshud gzhal med yongs rdzogs kyi// lha snam dbus su sna tshogs 'dab brgyad dbus// bdud bzhi'i steng du mngon byang lngas bskyed pa'i// rgyu yi rdo 'dzin he ru ka dkar po// zhal brgyad bcu drug phyag can zhabs bzhi pa// bdag med yum sbyor gar dgu'i nyams kyis rol// mkha' gsang byin rlabs snyoms zhugs bde ba'i sgras// de bzhin gshegs pa spyan drangs dbyibs brgyud de// sa bon brgyad kyi rnam par phyir 'thon pas// 'dab brgyad gdan steng lha mo gau rī// tsau rī bai ta ghasma pukka sī// ri khrod gdol ba g.yung mo rnams su gyur// slar yang rjes chags me yis yab yum zhu// bde chen 'od phung lha mo bzhis bskul bas// hūm̐ dang aṃ las 'bras bu rdo rje 'dzin// dbang sngon mdog can zhal brgyad rtsa zhal dang*// g.yas g.yon yang lhag rnam bzhi steng zhal bcas// sngo dkar dmar nag dud kha'i rang mdangs 'tsher// dbu skra gyen brdzes sna tshogs rdo rjes spras// spyan gsum rab brjid hi hi'i bzhad sgra sgrogs// rtsa phyag gnyis bsnol lhag ma mdzes par brkyangs// g.yas brgyad lag ldan rta bong glang rnga mong*// mi dang ri dwags rgyal po kun du la// g.yon brgyad sa chu me rlung zla nyi'i lha// gshin rje nor 'dzin rnams bzung gar dgur bsgyur// zhabs bzhi g.yas g.yon gnyis gnyis brkyangs bskum rol// skam rlon mgo phreng rus pa'i rgyan drug 'chang*// gri thod legs 'dzin shes rab bdag med ma// phyag rgya lnga yis 'khyud dang mnyam par sbyor// lha dgu so so'i thugs kar sa bon steng*// slad kor dang bcas sems dpa' gsum brtsegs las// 'od 'phros snod bcud lha dang gzhal yas gsal// de rnams phyi nang skye mched rdo rje gsum// lhar gsal thugs ka'i hūm̐ 'od pho nya yis// rgyal ba sras bcas yi dam lha'i rnam par// spyan drangs gnyis med thim pas rang gi lus// rten dang brten pa'i dkyil 'khor lam gyis gsal// srung 'khor 'byung bzhi ri rab gzhal yas khang*// phyi dkyil mtshan dpe ma zhig nang gnas sor// ma 'dres 'od kyi rang bzhin brten pa lha// pho brang lnga yi gtso bo 'khor bcas dang*// zhar byung lha bcas brgya dang lnga bcu bdun// lam dang sku bzhi rang chas lhun grub gyur// slar yang thugs ka'i 'od kyi dbang gi lha// gdan gsum tshang ba nam mkhar sa mā dzaḥ

/sa gzhi spos chus sogs maṇḍal/ oṃ a bhi ṣiñtsa tu maṃ/ sarba ta thā ga ta/ oṃ badzri bha wa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ dbang lhas dbang bskur phung lnga rgyal ba lnga// 'byung ba yum lnga skye mched sems ma'i gdan// tshigs chen khro bo'i rnam par gnas 'gyur te// de dag chos nyid rdo rje sems dpar gyur// 'di de sangs rgyas thams cad de// rdo rje sems dpa'i phyag na gnas// khyod kyis kyang ni rtag tu zungs// phyag na rdo rje'i brtul zhugs brtan// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta siddhi badzra sa mā ya tiṣṭha e ṣa st+waṃ dha ra ya mi badzra sa twa hiḥhi hi hi hi hūm̐/ brda yi rdo rje 'dis mtshon rang gi sems// rig stong blo 'das rgyal ba'i thugs su gyur// 'di ni rnal 'byor ma kun gyi// dril bu'i sgra kun rjes 'gror bshad// khyod kyis kyang ni rtag tu zung*// byang chub mchog tu rgyal ba bzhed// aḥ brda yi dril bu 'dis mtshon rang gi ngag /grags stong skye med rgyal ba'i gsung du gyur// rang lus snang stong dbyer med rdo rje 'chang*// yab yum 'od lus bde chen mnyam sbyor la// dbang lhas dbang bskur rang lus lha skur smin// ngag sngags yid ni chos sku sgo gsum dang*// bya byed rlung bcas ngo bo nyid skur smin// rgyal tshab rab gnas 'dod yon lam khyer gyis// rang lus rtsa la bum pa'i dbang bskur thob// bskyed rim la dbang sprul sku'i sa bon bzhag /ji ltar 'das pa'i sangs rgyas kyis// byang chub sras rnams dbang bskur ltar// bdag gis gsang ba'i dbang gis ni// sems kyi rgyun gyis dbang bskur ro// oṃ āḥhūm̐ hoḥ mgrin pa'i lam myang dus gsum rtog tshogs 'gags// gsang dbang rlung bsgom longs sku'i sa bon bzhag /dga' ster gnas ster lha mo ni// sna tshogs gzugs can yid 'ong ma// khyer cig khyer cig sems dpa' che// khyer la mchod pa dag tu gyis// snyoms 'jug dga' bzhi'i rtogs pa rgyud la skyes// gsum pa'i lam dbang chos sku'i sa bon bzhag

/ye shes 'di ni ches phra zhing*// rdo rje nam mkha'i dkyil lta bu// rdul bral mthar phyin zhi ba nyid// khyod rang yang ni de yi pha// gzhi yi 'od gsal lam du khyer ba yis// bzhi pa'i lam dbang ngo bo nyid sku thob// de ltar phung khams skye mched lha dang sngags// ye shes rol bas bskyed rim sdom pa thob// dkyil 'khor bzhi dang brten pa rang rig bcas// dbyings rig dbyer med rdzogs rim sdom pa thob// gtso bos ji ltar bka' stsal ba// de dag thams cad bdag gis bgyi// lan gsum/ sa gzhi spos chus sogs/ deng nas brtsams te bdag bran du// khyod la bdag ni 'bul lags na// khyod kyi slob mar bzung ba dang*// cha yis kyang ni spyad du gsol// dkyil 'khor bzhi la dbang bzhi thob pa yi// dbang gi chu rgyun yar lud rigs bdag mtshan// oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha ho hrīḥ lan gsum/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a mṛ ta swa da na badzra swa bhā wa ātma ko3haṃ/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pū dza badzra swa bhā wa ātma ko3haṃ/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta stu ti badzra swa bhā wa ātma ko3haṃ/ srung 'khor nas gtso bo yab yum bar spyi dang bye brag la sems bzung*/ rdzogs rim bsgom na 'dir bya/ dag dran ni/ snying rje'i spyan ni dmar po la// byams pa'i thugs la yan lag nag /bsdu ba'i dngos po bzhi yis ni// zhabs ni rnam pa bzhi zhes brjod// zhal brgyad rnam par thar pa brgyad// phyag ni stong pa bcu drug nyid// gug skyed kyis ni sangs rgyas lnga// gdug pa 'dul phyir khro bo nyid// de nyid gsum ni spyan gsum po// sha ni pukka sī ru brjod// de bzhin khrag ni ri khrod ma// gdol ba mo ni khu bar brjod// g.yung mo rkang dang tshil bu dag /pags pa byang chub yan lag bdun// rus pa bden pa bzhi po nyid// phreng sngags ni/ oṃ pa de pa de mahā dzñā na/ sarba buddha ma yaṃ bha wi te hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ ho ho ho a khaṃ swā hā/

bdun bzlas/ oṃ ru tsi ra ma ṇi pra wa ra dha na ye swā hā/ tshar gsum/ mdud 'dzin la ha btab/ bzlas pa ni/ oṃ aṣṭa na nā ya/ piṅga lordha ke sha warta ma ni/ tsa turbingsha te nai trā ya/ ṣau ḍa sha bhu dzā ya/ kriṣṇa dzī mu ta wa pu ṣe/ ka pā la mā lā ne kāṃ dhā ri ṇe/ ātma ta krū ra tsitta ya/ ardhentu daṃ ṣṭi ṇe/ oṃ mā ra ya mā ra ya/ kā ra ya kā ra ya/ gardza ya gardza ya/ tardza ya tardza ya/ sho ṣa ya sho ṣa ya/ sapta sā ga rā na/ bhandha bhandha/ nā ga aṣṭa kān/ grihṇa grihṇa sha trūn/ ha hā hi hī hu hū he hāe ho hau ham̐ haḥphaṭa swā hā/ zhes rtsa sngags dang*/ oṃ de wa pi tsu badzra hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ snying po dang*/ oṃ badzra kartā ri he badzra ya hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ nye snying*/ oṃ āḥ aṃ āṃ/ iṃ īṃ/ uṃ ūṃ/ ṛṃ ṝṃ/ liṃ līṃ/ eṃ aiṃ/ oṃ auoṃ/ aṃ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ phreng sngags so// oṃ āḥ.am̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ āḥnam̐ badzra nai rātma hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ yum gyi'o// oṃ āḥgam̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ hūm̐ phaṭ swā hā/ zhes pa de'ang gzhan la 'grel dgos/ oṃ āḥtsam̐= oṃ āḥbam̐= oṃ.āḥgham̐= oṃ āḥpam̐= oṃ āḥsham̐= oṃ āḥlam̐= oṃ ā ḍam̐ hūm̐ swā hā/ lha mo brgyad kyi 'o// yig brgya lan gsum bzlas/ bcom ldan dgyes pa rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor gyi// gsang ba gsum gyis bdag sogs byin rlabs te// myur du rdo rje 'dzin pa mngon gyur shog /snod bcud srung 'khor gzhal yas lha mo bcas// 'od zhu rang thim gtso bo yab yum yang*// 'od gsal dbyings bsdus mkha' las 'ja' tshon ltar// thun mtshams yi dam lha skur gsal bar gyur// gnyis 'dzin rtog tshogs ro snyoms ngang la spyod// mchog gsum shis pa'i don kun 'grub gyur cig /skye mched lha dang sgo gsum rdo rje gsum// snang grags lha sngags ye shes rgya yis btab// dge ba 'di yis nam mkha'i mtha' klas pa'i// lus can kun gyi bsod nams ye shes tshogs// myur du sgrub nas tshe 'di kho na la// rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sa la 'god par shog

/bla ma dkyil 'khor gtso bo 'khor dang bcas// sbyang gzhi dag byed lam dang 'bras bu bcas// brjod dam de don rtag tu dran yang rung*// bkra shis 'phel phyir rtag tu dran par 'gyur// dbang bzhi'i snang ba bskyed pa yi// sngon gsungs nyi zla rgyu skar phreng*// gsung ngag mkha' la mdzes bzhin du// 'di lta'i me khyer dgos pa ci// 'on kyang dpe dben ngal bso dang*// blo gsar mos pa'i bag chags ched// bshes gnyen bskul ngor myur bris 'di// 'gal dang ma 'brel dam par bshags// dge tshogs bdud rtsi'i zla ba yis// dbang bzhi'i chu gter cher 'phel te// don gnyis bcud du smin pa'i nor// skal ldan lag rtser thob gyur cig /ces pa 'di yang 1961 lcags glang lor chu mig brgya rtsa rdzong chos sder lam 'bras 'chad skabs/ ngor e waṃ chos ldan gyi rgan mkhyen yon can ngag dbang kun dga' mchog dang*/ rang gi mchod dpon dang nye gnas sogs nas lhag bsam gyis bskul ngor blo gsal mos ldan mang por rnam grol mchog gi bag chags 'jog pa'i cha rkyen du bco brgyad khri ming su bha ṣi tas chos dbar yud tsam zhig la sbyar ba/ blo mchog dang ldan pa dang*/ lam dus kyi dpe rgyas 'bring rnyed pa rnams kyi las slar dgongs te 'dis go chod pa mi mdzad pa gsol ba 'debs pa lags so/// /sarba maṅga laṃ// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten nye 'dabs nas rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa las/ slob bu tha shal pa gu rus spel ba'o//
